headline: Fed signals steady rates as inflation cools to 2.4%
body: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate unchanged, citing continued disinflation and a resilient labor market. Fund managers broadly read the tone as a green light for risk assets into year-end, though a handful flagged stretched valuations in large-cap growth names.
author: Profitdex Research Desk

headline: Nifty 50 closes flat as IT stocks offset banking gains
body: Domestic benchmark indices ended a choppy session little changed. Private banks advanced on strong deposit growth, while IT majors slipped after a cautious outlook from a global peer. Our equity desk maintains a neutral stance on the sector pending Q2 earnings.
author: Profitdex Research Desk

headline: Gold holds above key support as investors weigh rate path
body: Bullion consolidated near recent highs as traders balanced a firmer dollar against ongoing central bank accumulation. We continue to favor a modest strategic allocation to gold within diversified mandates as a hedge against policy surprises.
author: Profitdex Research Desk

headline: Small-cap mutual funds see fourth straight month of inflows
body: Retail participation in small-cap schemes continued to build, with net inflows extending a four-month streak. While the segment offers attractive long-term compounding, we remind clients that small-cap allocations should stay within their planned risk budget.
author: Profitdex Research Desk

headline: Crude oil slips on higher-than-expected inventory build
body: Oil prices fell after weekly data showed a larger stockpile increase than analysts anticipated. Energy-linked equities traded lower in sympathy, though refiners were comparatively resilient on improved crack spreads.
author: Profitdex Research Desk

headline: Quarterly review: balanced advantage funds outperform pure equity peers
body: Our latest review of dynamic asset allocation schemes shows a smoother return path versus pure equity funds over the trailing quarter, with roughly two-thirds of the drawdown. Clients focused on capital preservation may find this category worth a closer look.
author: Profitdex Research Desk
